concerns.text: Task T051 [P] anonymises `data/raw/real_ratings.csv` before any real rating data is produced. The required producer task (T015b‑Real) is defined later in Phase 3, violating the producer‑before‑consumer ordering rule.

Task T054 [P] computes a SHA‑256 checksum for `data/raw/real_ratings.csv` prior to the real‑data collection task (T015b‑Real). This places a consumer before its producer, breaking the required ordering.
Task T055 [P] records a checksum for `data/processed/cleaned_ratings.csv` before the cleaning step (T016) that creates this file, resulting in a consumer‑before‑producer violation.
Task T056 [P] records a checksum for `data/processed/sensitivity_report.csv` before the sensitivity analysis (Phase 5) that generates this report, violating the required ordering.
Task T050 [P] computes a checksum for `data/raw/stimuli.csv` before the stimulus generation task (T013) that creates the file. The checksum task should run after T013.

Task T010a creates a contract test for the stimulus schema but references `data/raw/stimuli.csv` which is only produced by T013. Since T010a appears after T013 it is correctly ordered, but the preceding checksum task T050 (see above) should precede T010a to ensure the file exists before testing.
